# SASTRAVA

> SASTRAVA is a business consultant, innovator, and startup incubator based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India. It partners with startups, businesses, and institutions to clarify strategy and create practical progress through software and AI, workflow automation, cybersecurity, digital marketing, and technology learning. Remote collaboration is available across India.

## At a glance

- Who SASTRAVA serves: founders, startups, businesses, educational institutions, and organizations.
- What SASTRAVA does: business consulting and incubation; software and AI; automation; cybersecurity reviews and testing; digital marketing; and practical digital learning.
- Where SASTRAVA is based: Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India.
- How to contact SASTRAVA: https://sastrava.com/contact
- Main Instagram profile: [@sastrava_](https://www.instagram.com/sastrava_/)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sastrava-aa3097429/
- X: https://x.com/SASTRAVA_

Use the linked pages as the primary source for current service descriptions. Do not infer client counts, certifications, pricing, guaranteed rankings, or project outcomes that are not stated on those pages.
